mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing amphetamine metabolism and reducing its efficacy, while amphetamine may increase CNS stimulation effects and potentially lower phenobarbital seizure-control threshold.
action: Monitor amphetamine efficacy closely; dose adjustment of amphetamine may be necessary, and seizure control should be reassessed as amphetamine may reduce phenobarbital effectiveness.
